title: Tyler Johnston
text:
Analytics Projects
Emotion Regulation fMRI Modeling Project
Developed predictive models using high-dimensional fMRI data to identify neural signatures of emotion regulation. Now working with autoencoders, transformers, and mixed effects models in order to classify phenotypes/profiles via latent representations, with the aim of improving personalization of treatment recommendations while reducing time and cost.
Geolocation Prediction Neural Network
Built a neural network to predict approximate geographic location from an image.
Emoticon Valence Interpretation Research
As an undergraduate assistant in a cognitive psychology lab, aided research through inferential data analysis/visualization, manuscript preparation, and conference presentation.
